comment: Six questions about the franklin.epub fixture (Gutenberg #20203), each with the spine index the reader has finished. Spine 1 is the front matter, the editor's introduction and the letter that opens 'DEAR SON'; spine 2 is 'Josiah, my father'; spine 6 is 'In 1736 I lost one of my sons, a fine boy of four years old, by the small-pox'. The book is here because Alice cannot express the shape the bug was reported in: a memoir has an author in it, a preface by somebody else, and a Gutenberg header printing 'Author: Benjamin Franklin' for the word to match on. Every expectation was read off the fixture's own text.
